claim: Sagrada Família official individual tickets in 2026: basic €26, with guided tour €30, with tower €36, guided tour plus tower €40; all include audio guide and app.
quote: Sagrada Família - €26 ... Sagrada Família with Guided Tour - €30 ... Sagrada Família with Tower - €36 ... Sagrada Família with Guided Tour and Tower - €40 ... All tickets include access to the official mobile application and audio guide services.

claim: Sagrada Família has no physical ticket office and sells out days in advance in 2026 due to the Gaudí centenary; book early online; the basilica reached its full 172.5 m height in February 2026, making it the world's tallest church.
quote: There is no longer a physical ticket office. All tickets are sold exclusively online ... In 2026, Gaudí's centenary is driving high demand ... Tickets often sell out several days in advance ... the basilica now reaches its maximum height of 172.5 m, making it the tallest church in the world.

claim: Park Güell's Monumental Zone is advance-booking only with no walk-up tickets; the 2026 basic ticket is about €18 after a steep increase, youth (7-15) about €7, under 6 free; you must arrive within 30 minutes of your timed slot.
quote: The Monumental Zone is advance-booking only with no walk-up tickets ... you have 30 minutes after the time marked on your ticket to enter the site—once that deadline passes, you will lose your right to enter ... since the beginning of 2026 there has been an 80% increase to €18.

claim: Park Güell sells to capacity weeks ahead in summer (June-August); weekday early mornings are calmest, weekends busiest; capacity sells out so book two to three weeks ahead.
quote: weekends typically being the busiest—for a more calm experience, consider visiting on weekdays and early mornings ... Check availability two to three weeks before your visit, especially from June through August when the park consistently sells to capacity.

claim: La Pedrera (Casa Milà) official tickets: Essential day visit from €25 (includes rooftop and videoguide in 11 languages), Night Experience and Sunrise from €39.50, Open Date flexible €45, Premium small-group from €120.
quote: The Essential La Pedrera - From €25 ... La Pedrera Night Experience - From €39.50 ... La Pedrera Sunrise - From €39.50 ... La Pedrera Open Date - From €45 ... La Pedrera Premium - From €120

claim: Casa Batlló official tickets: General Visit from €29 (audioguide, AR tablet for kids), Be the First morning skip-the-line €45, Night Visit from €25 with a drink, Magical Nights visit plus concert from €59; under-12s free.
quote: General Visit - Starting price: €29 ... Morning Visit "Be the First" - Price: €45 (fixed) ... skip-the-line, fewer visitors ... Night Visit - Starting price: €25 ... Visit + Concert "Magical Nights" - Starting price: €59 ... Children (0-12) receive free entry across most offerings.

claim: If choosing one, Casa Milà offers better value and less crowding than the smaller, often-overcrowded Casa Batlló, whose entry is pricier; ideally visit both as each is a masterpiece.
quote: Casa Mila is better in my opinion and gives more value for your money ... Casa Batlló is a smaller building, and in the high season, it feels very crowded ... Casa Milà is a larger space ... visit both if you can, as each one is a masterpiece in its own right.

claim: Casa Batlló is worth it; the Blue/General tier excludes the rooftop so Silver or higher is recommended; visit early morning or late afternoon on weekdays to dodge crowds, and book online to save €4 and skip ticket-office lines.
quote: Best value: Silver or higher tier (Blue excludes the rooftop) ... Early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds ... Weekdays instead of weekends ... Book tickets online in advance to save €4 and bypass ticket office lines.

claim: Casa Vicens, Gaudí's first house, costs about €20-21 for adults (under-10s free) with audio guide in 15 languages included; open daily 9:30am-8pm Apr-Oct and to 6pm Nov-Mar; it is far less crowded than Casa Batlló or Sagrada Família.
quote: Standard skip-the-line tickets start at €20 for adults ... open daily (9:30 am–8 pm April–October; 9:30 am–6 pm November–March) ... Casa Vicens is one of Barcelona's most underrated Gaudí landmarks — still less crowded than Casa Batlló or the Sagrada Família.

claim: Palau Güell, a lesser-known central Gaudí palace, costs €15 for adults in 2026 (€12 reduced for 18-25 and over-65, €5 for 13-17, under-12 free) with audio guide included.
quote: Adult admission is EUR 15, with reduced rates of EUR 12 for young people aged 18–25 and seniors over 65, EUR 5 for children aged 13–17, and free admission for children under 12 ... an audio guide is included in the price of admission.
